class.name: SimpleWorldObjectProfile
class.brief_description: Placeable object definition for SimpleTerrain world editing.
class.description: [SimpleWorldObjectProfile] describes one object that can be placed on a [SimpleTerrain3D] surface. Placement records reference this resource through [member id] instead of storing a scene directly, allowing existing placements to be regenerated when the registered scene or placement settings change.

members.member: If [code]true[/code], generated instances may align their up axis to the sampled terrain normal.
Editor grouping label, such as [code]Trees[/code], [code]Rocks[/code], or [code]Grass[/code].
Approximate object radius used by placement tools for spacing and overlap checks.
Brush, scatter, or grass density multiplier.
Human-readable label shown by editor UI.
Maximum terrain height allowed for automatic placement.
Minimum terrain height allowed for automatic placement.
Stable identifier used by [SimpleWorldPlacementData] records.
Maximum random instance scale.
Minimum random instance scale.
Avoidance layers to apply when runtime code creates a [NavigationObstacle3D] for this profile.
If [code]true[/code], baked static obstructions carve the navigation mesh instead of only adding an obstruction volume.
Height of the navigation obstruction generated for this profile.

Controls whether placed objects from this profile are ignored by navigation, included in [SimpleTerrain3D] navmesh baking, receive a runtime [NavigationObstacle3D] when placed by the SimpleTerrain editor, or both.
Radius of the circular navigation obstruction generated for this profile.

Controls how the navigation obstacle shape is generated. [constant NAVIGATION_OBSTACLE_SHAPE_RADIUS] uses [member navigation_obstacle_radius] and [member navigation_obstacle_height]. [constant NAVIGATION_OBSTACLE_SHAPE_SCENE_COLLISION] reads supported [CollisionShape3D] nodes from [member scene], using box shapes as rectangular obstacles and sphere, capsule, or cylinder shapes as circular obstacles. [constant NAVIGATION_OBSTACLE_SHAPE_MESH_AABB] reads [MeshInstance3D] mesh bounds and uses each mesh AABB as a rectangular obstacle.
Preferred placement mode for this profile.
Optional icon or thumbnail for editor palettes.
If [code]true[/code], placement tools may randomize rotation around the Y axis.
Scene instantiated when placement data is rebuilt.

Free-form labels for future filters and editor queries.

constants.constant: Grass placement, usually generated with multimesh instances.
Placed objects from this profile are ignored by SimpleTerrain navigation obstacle handling.
Placed objects from this profile are included as static obstructions when [SimpleTerrain3D.bake_navigation] is called.
Placed objects from this profile receive runtime avoidance obstacles when placed by the SimpleTerrain editor, but are not included in the baked navmesh.
Placed objects from this profile are included in baked navigation and may also create runtime avoidance obstacles.
Uses the profile's radius and height fields to generate a simple circular obstacle.
Uses supported [CollisionShape3D] nodes in the profile scene to generate obstacle footprints.
Uses [MeshInstance3D] mesh AABBs in the profile scene to generate rectangular obstacle footprints.
